Table QR Code

Ye QR code print karke har table par lagayein. Customer apne mobile se scan kare ga to yehi menu khul jaye ga — na koi app, na koi intezaar.

  1. Neeche apne menu ka link likhein
  2. QR code khud-ba-khud ban jaye ga
  3. “QR Download Karein” dabakar print kar lein
